##### Project general facts

11 Hills Park is a prestigious residential development of studios and one-bedroom apartments in Dubai Science Park, overlooking lush greenery and parkland in Al Barsha South. The architectural structure includes a ground floor, podium levels, residential floors, and a rooftop, presenting a fresh, functional design that blends seamlessly into the surrounding environment. This thoughtfully designed community combines comfort, convenience, and a focus on well-being, offering a serene retreat in the bustling city.

Residents enjoy access to an impressive array of amenities catering to various lifestyles, including two swimming pools and fitness centers, a jogging track, a basketball court, a captivating garden, a paddle tennis court, and a multi-purpose sports area. Separate swimming pools for men and women, cutting-edge gyms for fitness enthusiasts, and versatile living spaces filled with natural light from large windows create an ideal environment for relaxation, socialization, and personal growth.

Every residence at 11 Hills Park features contemporary, high-quality finishes that prioritize functionality and style. Apartments are designed with high ceilings in principal rooms and floor-to-ceiling double-glazed windows for natural light and energy efficiency. Interiors include porcelain tile flooring with a matte timber effect, custom-designed fire-resistant doors with smart locks, and laminated modern interior doors with magnetic hardware. Kitchens feature white cabinetry, quartz countertops, glass backsplashes, and built-in appliances, while bedrooms are equipped with custom-designed wardrobes, ensuring a seamless and secure living experience.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Dubai Science Park (DSP) in Al Barsha South, this vibrant district is a dedicated hub designed to foster innovation in science, energy, and environmental sectors. Home to more than three hundred organizations with a modern infrastructure tailored to research and development, DSP is a cornerstone of Dubai's push towards a knowledge-based economy, offering cutting-edge facilities and a collaborative environment for professionals in scientific fields.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional connectivity and family-friendly amenities. Dubai Hills Mall, Mall of the Emirates, Jumeirah Beach, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Mall, and both Dubai International and Al Maktoum International Airports are all within easy reach. The area combines business excellence with residential convenience, providing modern housing options alongside essential amenities such as schools, fitness centers, and medical facilities, making it ideal for both families and professionals looking to balance work and personal life.

For those seeking a residence that embodies innovation, sustainability, and a prime location, Dubai Science Park delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of green spaces, pedestrian-friendly areas, and community-focused amenities makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — connected, tranquil and effortlessly inspiring.
